name: mantaprint-hub
changelog: Fix: two USB scanners at once were invisible (SANE probe timeout 6s -> 25s); every scanner is listed, Admin > Scanner picks the default and Scan Studio picks per scan; HP MFP A4 scans no longer fail on the platen geometry (clamped to 215.9 x 296.9 mm, retry without -x/-y).
Fix: install.sh aborted with 'SUDO_USER: unbound variable' when run directly as root.
Fix: Overview > Services layout on phones (short Standby pill, explanation in the description, status and Restart wrap to their own line).
